svg.title: Engineering principles
svg.desc: Engineering principles. 01 Ship early: Real users surface problems planning never will. 02 Design for scale on day one: Stateless APIs, CDN first, SQL where queries get complex. 03 Observability is architecture: Logs, alerts and dashboards ship with the product. 04 Pick the right tool: The trade-off matters more than familiarity. 05 Own the outcome: The deliverable is the running, monitored system — not the commit. 06 Communicate clearly: Async first, unprompted updates, no surprises.
